messages.subject: scale_manual and multiple legends
parts:
hi,

I have a dataframe and I want to map the colors, size and shape to one
single factor variable. For one of these factors I would like to modify
the size manually (using scale_size_manual), but this results in two
legends being displayed.

How can I avoid this, is scale_size_manual the wrong way?

A small example:

ggplot(diamonds) + geom_point(aes(x=carat, y=price, colour=cut,
size=cut)) + scale_size_manual("", values=c("Fair"=3, "Good"=.5, "Very
Good" = .5, "Premium"=.5, "Ideal"=.5))


thanks!

regards,
stefan

> Just make sure the labels are all the same:

> +labels(x='Carat',y='Price',colour='Cut',size='Cut')

+labels(...) does not work, but I found +labs(...) and that works:

+ labs(x="carat", y="price", colour="cut", size="cut")

it works, but the newline between "Very Good" is of course wrong.
